$description: Every usable design token, one entry per id, with its resolved value, category and citations. GENERATED by extraction/build_token_catalog.py from tokens/00-foundation, 10-semantic, 20-component and 30-layout; do not edit by hand (verify_all.py rebuilds it and fails on any difference). source.file + source.pointer locate the authored token; measuredFrom is the evidence citation registered in extraction/measured-values.json (or a histogram description). Which categories and ids a PageSpec may reference is decided by tokens/llm/token-policy.json, not by this file. Theme instances (tokens/themes/*.json) map roles onto semantic.* ids and are not separate tokens.
